review_basis: Fresh manual read of all 11 source files from module overview through 53 graph-mapped definition bodies; no historical audit verdict inherited. AST/hash checks only bind that review to source.
scope_limits: Static inspection only; no project imports, target execution, tests, model calls, credentials, network access, source edits or pushes.
All definition bodies were read, but security/evidence/source-identity and scoring policy semantics are not certified. The per-definition semantic_review_limits field records affected interfaces.
Contextual snippets outside models are not credited as audited function coverage.
Inspected is not equivalent to passed, defect-free, dynamically validated, independently reviewed or paired.
